newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY-SALLIE MAE FLOATING RATE NOTE SCHEDULE.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY-SALLIE MAE FLOATING RATE NOTE SCHEDULE.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Monday that its monthly short-term floating rate note announcement will be held Friday, August 15 after 11.45 a.m. EDT (1545 GMT).
The pricing of the note will be held Monday, August 18 after 2.00 p.m. EDT (1800 GMT).
Sallie Mae said it will also announce on Friday, September 12, with pricing to follow on Monday, September 15.
Sallie Mae usually announces its floating rate note on the Friday before the second Thursday and prices the following Monday, but it revised its schedule.
